title: Robust quantum key distribution with imperfections in state preparation and characterization
summary: Quantum key distribution (QKD) offers an approach for secure communication over quantum channels, based on the principles of quantum mechanics. However, the inevitable imperfections in QKD systems can introduce critical vulnerabilities, posing significant challenges to the deployment of QKD in terms of both practical security and performance. In this work, we present a comprehensive security analysis of QKD in the practical scenarios involving imperfections in modulation spaces.
